title: How to Contact Instagram Support | Instagram Guide Part 11
description: We'll walk you through the steps to getting in touch with Instagram customer service in case you are having problems with your account or have seen something suspicious on Instagram that you'd like to report. More information on how to get in touch with Instagram is also provided below.  To contact Instagram, go to your Settings, then scroll down and tap Report a Problem. Select the reason why you want to contact Instagram. Type in what you would like to ask the customer support team. When you're finished typing your comment or question, tap the Send button in the top right corner.  Here are some other ways to get in touch with Instagram: You can email them at [EMAIL]. However, most people who try to contact Instagram through email do not receive a response.  You can fill out Instagram's online contact form here: https://help.instagram.com/contact/364531043625021  Reach out to Instagram on their social media pages: Instagram on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/InstagramEnglish Instagram on Twitter: https://twitter.com/instagram  #InstagramGuide #InstagramTutorial  Do you learn better by reading? A text version is available at: https://techboomers.com/t/how-to-contact-instagram  Visit http://www.techboomers.com for over 100 free courses on all of today's most popular websites & apps!

asr.full_text: Are you having a problem with Instagram? Want to report your issue to their support team? If you want to contact Instagram customer support, we'll show you how. I'm Jessica from TechBoomers.com. In this video, I'll show you how to report something on Instagram. Now let's get started! Start by opening the Instagram app on your device. Tap the button in the bottom right corner to go to your profile page. On your profile, click the gear button in the top right corner to go to your settings. On the next screen, scroll down and tap Report a Problem From the menu that appears, select the nature of your issue On the next screen type in the details of your issue or question. When you're done, hit send. And that's it! Your issue has been reported to Instagram. Once you report an issue to Instagram, Instagram will look into the issue. You likely won't be contacted by Instagram unless the circumstances require it. And that's all there is to contacting Instagram customer service. If you'd like to learn more about Instagram and how to use it, check out our free Instagram course on techboomrs.com. Thanks for watching. If you found this video helpful, we'd love it if you'd click the thumbs up button below. Check out techboomrs.com for over a hundred free courses on all of today's most popular websites and apps.
